title: Jewel Toned Moroccan Lamb Tagine
description: A flavorful and nutritious Moroccan dish featuring lamb, paprika, and bonito flakes, perfect for a post-workout meal. This recipe is macrobiotic-friendly and packed with umami flavor.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the lamb pieces and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the onion and garlic and cook until the onion is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the paprika, bonito flakes, salt, and pepper.
Add the prunes and chicken broth, and bring to a boil.
Cover the Dutch oven and transfer to the preheated oven.
Braise the tagine for 2 1/2 hours, or until the lamb is tender.
Remove the tagine from the oven and let it cool slightly.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
